//: DEPENDENCY PIN RATIONALE (kept here because npm parses comment keys inside dependencies{} as package names):

vite: pinned to 7.x — electron-vite@5 peerDependency is 'vite: ^5 || ^6 || ^7'. Vite 8 is published but NOT yet supported by electron-vite 5; bumping it breaks the install. This cascades: @vitejs/plugin-react is held at 5.2.0 (last line supporting Vite 7; v6 requires Vite 8). Revisit all three together when electron-vite ships Vite 8 support.
typescript-eslint / react-i18next: bumped past the CLAUDE.md baseline to versions whose TypeScript peer range includes TS 6 (8.61.0 and 17.0.8 respectively).
libsodium-wrappers-sumo: the '-sumo' build is required — the standard build omits crypto_pwhash (Argon2id), which the KDF in src/main/crypto depends on.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
